comment: Ground truth: five defects injected into PR #896's merged change (base c030bed^). A finding matches a defect when its file path ends with file_suffix AND (its line falls within line_window OR its description matches regex, case-insensitive). line_window null means file+regex only (D5 is an absence; D4 is any touch of the file).

defects.nature: off-by-one: classify_pushed_prefix returns first_unpushed + 1, misclassifying the first unpushed commit as pushed so the squash base lands on an unpushed commit and one session commit escapes the collapse
argument swap: _is_ancestor(remote_head, sha) asks whether the remote head is an ancestor of each session commit, inverting pushed-ness classification
weakened assertion: test_collapses_three_unpushed_commits_into_one asserts len(session) >= 1, which any history satisfies, so the named exactly-one property is never asserted
anti-scope violation: the diff edits plugins/workbench/skills/vault-sync/references/command.md, which SPEC explicitly declares untouched (companion issue #893's footprint)
missing specced guard: SPEC promises staged-but-uncommitted changes report skipped, but the diff contains no staged-changes (git diff --cached) guard
